title: One Million Breath Note
creator: Studio Sunheart
description: An oversized fictional note exploring the idea that attention — not paper — is the scarcest currency. A meditation on what we actually spend.

title: Fiat as Myth — Engraving No.3
creator: A. Vance
educational_theme: All money is a designed object of collective trust
description: A fine-line engraving essay: every banknote is already a story we agree to believe. This piece makes the belief visible.

title: Ojai Reset Note
creator: Ojai Wellness Studio
educational_theme: Capacity backing — value secured by a provider's ability to perform
description: A verified provider turns an idle appointment slot into a tradable, redeemable experience note. Book it, gift it, or hold it — then redeem for the real session.

title: Camp Zen Retreat Seat
creator: Zen Village · Camp Zen
educational_theme: Unused retreat capacity becomes a circulating asset
description: An empty seat is worth nothing. A Retreat Seat Note makes that capacity liquid before it's redeemed — the Zen Village bridge in action.

title: Ten Hundreds — Framed
creator: M. Okafor
educational_theme: An art note conveys a claim to the object — not cash
description: A physical artwork incorporating ten visible $100 bills under glass. The note conveys ownership/claim to the physical piece; auction floor 1,000 credits. Not a cash instrument.

title: Fi-art Salon Note
creator: Fi-art
redeemable_for: Admission: 1 person, private dinner + money-mythology discussion
educational_theme: Access as a form of value — community, not cash
description: Admits one person to a private dinner and discussion on money mythology. Value here is belonging and experience, not redemption to currency.

title: Mirror Note #100A
creator: Art Holder A
educational_theme: Reserve backing — the strictest, most regulated promise
description: PREVIEW ONLY (Phase 5). The most sensitive note type: a fiat-linked claim against a verified reserve. Cash exits gate by jurisdiction, identity, limits, and approved partners. Shown here to teach how reserve backing works — not yet live.
